service_functions.description:
The engine control unit stores calibration values for the electronic throttle twistgrip, including its minimum and maximum positions. Resetting this adaptation clears the learned calibration values.

This adaptation should be reset after replacing the throttle twistgrip, handlebar controls, or the engine control unit. The throttle grip will be recalibrated during the adaptation procedure.

service_functions.description:
The engine control unit stores the learned closed and fully open positions of the electronic throttle valves. Resetting this adaptation clears the stored positions and allows the throttle valves to be recalibrated.

This adaptation should be reset after replacing the throttle body, throttle actuator, or the engine control unit.
service_functions.label: Throttle valve

service_functions.description:
The transmission control unit stores calibration values for the gear position sensor to accurately identify Neutral and gears 1–6. Resetting this adaptation clears the stored calibration and returns the system to its default state.

This adaptation should only be reset after replacing transmission-related components, the gear position sensor, or when instructed by a BMW service procedure.
service_functions.label: Transmission

service_functions.description:
